display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — GST Rates by Product
formula_sql: SELECT hsncode, product_category, tax_igst_rate, tax_cgst_rate, tax_sgst_rate, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, SUM(total_tax) AS tax_collected FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY hsncode, product_category, tax_igst_rate, tax_cgst_rate, tax_sgst_rate
